question.text: The variation of refractive index of a crown glass thin prism with wavelength of the incident light is shown. Which of the following graphs is the correct one, if $D_{m}$ is the angle of minimum deviation?

solution.text:
When angle of prism is small, then angle of deviation

is given by $\mathrm{D}_{\mathrm{m}}=(\mu-1) \mathrm{A}$

So, if wavelength of incident light is increased, $\mu$ decreases

and hence $\mathrm{D}_{\mathrm{m}}$ decreases.
